annotation.evidence_span: Implemementations SHOULD either use pacing or reduce their congestion window to limit such bursts.
annotation.interpretation_a: The clause allows implementations to either use pacing or reduce cwnd, but does not specify whether both can be used or whether one must be chosen exclusively.
annotation.justification: The clause’s use of "either … or" leaves open whether both mechanisms may be employed or whether one must be chosen exclusively, creating an incomplete constraint that permits materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: Whether implementations may use both pacing and cwnd reduction simultaneously, or must choose one exclusively.
